title: 콜래트럴
ctx: Film 「Collateral」(2004, DreamWorks/Paramount, director Michael Mann). Tom Cruise as Vincent, a cold contract killer hired to murder five witnesses in one night in Los Angeles; Jamie Foxx as Max Durocher, a meticulous cab driver who dreams of starting a limousine company and is forced to drive Vincent; Jada Pinkett Smith as Annie Farrell, a federal prosecutor whom Max drives at the start and who is Vincent's final target; Mark Ruffalo as Detective Ray Fanning, an LAPD narcotics detective who realizes a cabbie is involved; Peter Berg as Detective Richard Weidner; Bruce McGill as FBI agent Frank Pedrosa; Barry Shabaka Henley as Daniel, a jazz club owner; Irma P. Hall as Ida, Max's mother in hospital; Javier Bardem as Felix Reyes-Torrena, the drug cartel boss who hired Vincent.
